item.description:
MAMAMOO ONLINE CONCERT 2021 'WAW' (1080p HD)​



The 2021 MAMAMOO ONLINE CONCERT 'WAW' is MAMAMOO's third concert, their first online concert, and their concert for the WAW project. It was held on August 28, 2021 at 7 PM KST and was available for streaming on Seezn and Olleh TV in South Korea, and on KAVECON for overseas.

Note: This video was ripped from the DVD release and upscaled to 1080p.



More information: https://mamamoo.fandom.com/wiki/2021_MAMAMOO_ONLINE_CONCERT_'WAW'

item.title: 【HD Live Performances】BDRiP - G-DRAGON 2017 WORLD TOUR [ACT III, M.O.T.T.E] IN JAPAN (1080p HD)
item.description:
G-DRAGON 2017 WORLD TOUR [ACT III, M.O.T.T.E] IN JAPAN (1080p HD)​



The Act III: M.O.T.T.E 'Moment of Truth The End' World Tour (referred to as Act III: M.O.T.T.E) was the second concert tour by South Korean rapper and singer-songwriter G-Dragon. It was in support of his self-titled EP Kwon Ji Yong (2017). The tour began on June 10, 2017, in Seoul and concluded on October 8, 2017, in Taipei, Taiwan.



More information: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Act_III:_M.O.T.T.E_World_Tour
